label: s1_sub_021_gmother_01
text: I was cleaning out one of the warehouses when\nI found these. Not sure what to do with them...\r\nDo you think you could take them off my hands?[VAR 0x0114(0037)]

label: s1_sub_021_system_01
text: You got the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Festival Jinbei (White / Gray)[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] and\nthe [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Festival Jinbei (Deep Blue)[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!

label: s1_sub_021_gmother_02
text: Neither Carmine nor Kieran fit this size\nanymore...[VAR 0x0114(0037)]

label: s1_sub_021_gmother_03
text: I know the colors match my grandkids’ jinbei,\nbut don’t worry—these aren’t hand-me-downs.\r\nThey’re practically brand-new![VAR 0x0114(0037)]

label: s1_sub_021_gmother_04
text: Kids... They grow up so fast. Hee hee![VAR 0x0114(0037)]

label: s1_sub_021_gfatherr_01
text: With those two gone, the whole house just feels\nso...quiet. I wonder when they’ll be back next.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
